name: [🎃] The Mimic
desc:
NIGHTMARE CIRCUS RETURNS!

Icon & Thumbnail Art by EMANAS

ABOUT:  Four stories created from Japanese history and urban legends with a twist. In each book, you will find yourself as different characters venturing into the unknown depths of worlds that mimics our reality.

WARNING: This game contains Flashing lights, Loud Noises & Jumpscares!


Join the group for updates and your support:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/9482918/CTStudio#!/about




For the best experience use headphones.


Tags: Horror, Japan

llm.loop: play through story books based on Japanese legends -> solve puzzles and evade monsters -> chapters and seasonal events like the Nightmare Circus
llm.objectives: survive and finish each book's chapters
llm.progression: books and chapters, event trials, saves
llm.instructions: use headphones; four stories from Japanese history and urban legends
monetization_signals: limited Lord of the Night pass
llm.thumbnails: painted horror art: an evil clown, a masked witch with a crystal ball, a chained demon
llm.complexity_notes: studio-scale story horror with many chapters, custom monsters and cinematics
